description: Vectorized building rooftop prints of the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau and its neighboring regions is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Tao Ye et al. Large-scale high-precision building distribution data is important fundation for regional urban planning and resource allocation and disaster risk research. The Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau is the third pole of the world. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Image. The data are held in the data repository named in the paper and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
